key_idea: The colours take turns, so the bead next to each cover tells you how the hidden beads start.
steps: The beads go blue, red, blue, red, and so on.
Just before the first cover is a blue bead. So its 5 hidden beads are red, blue, red, blue, red. That is 3 red beads.
Just before the second cover is a blue bead too. So its 3 hidden beads are red, blue, red. That is 2 red beads.

choice_feedback.A: The first cover hides 3 red beads and the second hides 2, so 4 is too few.
choice_feedback.C: The second cover hides only 3 beads, and just 2 of them are red.
choice_feedback.D: That is too many. A blue bead sits between every 2 red beads.
choice_feedback.E: 8 is all the hidden beads, red and blue together.
